verdict.rationale: Aircall is a SaaS platform with public developer docs, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only conventional human-oriented API references and tutorials. The references to 'agents' concern call-center staff and Aircall's own AI voice agents, not docs built for AI coding agents to consume. There is no evidence of llms.txt or machine-readable agent docs.
